label: Icelandic public pension
name: Name
residenceYears: Years of insured residence in Iceland
residenceHelp: Enter the years from age 16 to 67. Three years qualify under domestic rules and 40 years give full entitlement.
incomeHelp: Use your expected gross employment income while claiming, in 2026 money.
otherIncomeHelp: In 2026 money, include mandatory occupational pension, your share of capital income and any other income the Icelandic Social Insurance Administration counts.
startHelp: Pension is paid on the first of the month. An age uses the month after the birthday. Early payment has separate qualifying rules.
earlyHelp: Check if all mandatory pension funds have approved your claim by the selected start and you meet the minimum combined pension requirement.
deferralHelp: Check if you have deferred the state pension and, if born in 1958 or later, all applicable mandatory occupational pensions until this start.
minimumResidence: Below the three-year domestic qualifying period
invalidOwner: Choose a person for the pension.
invalidBirth: Enter the pension recipient’s birth year and month in the profile.
invalidStart: Choose a valid age, date or milestone. An event without a known date requires a non-negative offset.
